mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 1200) indicates a contraction in both manufacturing and construction sectors, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market is tight, leading to inflationary pressures and preemptive Fed rate hikes, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for residential construction, which signals economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls level above 145,000 (thousands of persons) indicates a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 145000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising consumer credit (RSAFS > 470,000 million) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals strong monetary support for consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with consumer credit expansion
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 470000 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shocks (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output contraction leads to higher input costs and reduced corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
